aluminum_melting_1_subtask_structure_ret.name: Aluminum Structure Retrieval for Melting - Level 1
aluminum_melting_1_subtask_structure_ret.description: Retrieve structure of Aluminum and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

aluminum_melting_1_subtask_potential_fil.name: Aluminum Potential File for Melting - Level 1
aluminum_melting_1_subtask_potential_fil.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_melting_1_subtask_melting.name: Aluminum NPT Melting - Level 1
aluminum_melting_1_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum structure file and EAM potential file, simulate melting under NPT with the given simulation parameters. Return the path to the trajectory file and the final density of the melt in g/cm^3.

aluminum_melting_1_subtask_diffusivity.name: Aluminum Diffusivity Calculation - Level 1
aluminum_melting_1_subtask_diffusivity.description: Given the path to the trajectory file from the melting simulation, compute the mean squared displacement (MSD) of Al atoms over the trajectory using the MDAnalysis library. Identify the melting point as the first frame where the MSD shows a sudden jump, ignoring the first 50 ps of simulation. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state using the MSD after the detected melting point, and report the average value in m²/s.
